scenario.title: After the Weekend Soccer Match
scenario.context: On a Monday morning, at a bustling bakery near the park where a local community soccer match was held during the weekend
scenario.description: Two friends meet for breakfast and discuss their performance during the weekend soccer match. The bakery is filled with the aroma of fresh bread and pastries, with the sounds of espresso machines hissing in the background. Outside, the sunny day signal the start of a new week.
scenario.speaker1_persona: Elias is a considerate and emotionally expressive person. He is open about his feelings and comfortable sharing his disappointments and successes.
scenario.speaker2_persona_1: High EQ - Dora is a thoughtful listener and relates to Elias's feelings. She is supportive and expresses her feelings openly and constructively.
scenario.speaker2_persona_2: Low EQ - Dora is dismissive of Elias's feelings. She tends to avoid discussing her feelings and may respond defensively when her performance is discussed.
scenario.speaker2_persona_3: Low EQ - Dora is passive-aggressive. She finds it hard to express her feelings directly and often use sarcasm or indirect communication to express her dissatisfaction.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: Man, you were on fire at the match this weekend!

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: Ah, thanks! But I fumbled that one goal, it's been bothering me.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: Come on, don't beat yourself up. Everyone makes mistakes.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: I know, but I can't help feeling I let the team down.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: Trust me, you didn't. We win as a team, lose as a team. Plus, that pastry smell is making me forget everything else!

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: You're right, no point dwelling on it. Let's focus on these amazing pastries instead.
